test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Raveena has made / up her mind to / carried minimum / luggage with her.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect form of the verb** "carried" used after "to."**
 
• In English, the infinitive form of the verb should be used after "to."
 
• The correct phrase should be **"to carry minimum,"** ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Raveena has made up her mind **to carry minimu**m luggage with her."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Raveena has made," **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 2: "up her mind to,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "luggage with her."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
